facts.claim: Factory VIN position 7 A identifies 6AT FWD, position 8 Z identifies 2.0T A20NFT/LHU, position 10 B identifies model year 2011.
Saab Parts advisory extends cold-intake-valve face-wear symptom to 2011 NG9-5 A20NFT; true cold compression/leakdown is specified; failure frequency unknown.
Factory AF40 level checking requires scan-tool-observed ATF temperature 70–80 C and engine running under specified procedures.
Factory generic cooling description includes coolant level reporting via BCM and an ATF-to-coolant radiator-integrated heat exchanger; exact VIN/engine variant must be checked.
Generic WIS cooling prose describes belt-driven water pump while specific 2.0L service index documents water-pump/balance-shaft chain; exact LHU procedure/hardware governs.
GNE FWD rear support can be disassembled/replaced by factory procedure; body mounting integrity and GNC versus GNE identity not proved by that alone.

investigation_cases.title: cold intake valve sealing
investigation_cases.lead_symptoms: Overnight cold no-start, starts/stalls, P0300-P0304; normal hot operation does not clear risk
investigation_cases.required_tests: Professionally measured truly cold compression and leak-down; retain raw per-cylinder values
investigation_cases.caution: Do not mislabel ignition fault or approve internal head work from codes alone

investigation_cases.title: oil pressure / bearings / pump / pickup
investigation_cases.lead_symptoms: Oil-pressure warning, knock, noise; poor service history
investigation_cases.required_tests: Safe qualified mechanical pressure test at documented temp/RPM; inspect pickup/pump/filter/sender
investigation_cases.caution: No cranking when suspected oil-starved or seized

investigation_cases.title: timing and balance-shaft chain
investigation_cases.required_tests: Inspect with WIS method; verify mechanical health before running
investigation_cases.caution: Separate water-pump/balance chain and primary chain; no blanket replacement interval

investigation_cases.title: returnless fuel control / direct injection
investigation_cases.lead_symptoms: No start, fuel pressure error, misfire
investigation_cases.required_tests: Get ECM and pump-module data; test low-pressure vs high-pressure sides with approved instruments
investigation_cases.caution: Do not condemn HP fuel pump or work on pressurized lines from symptom alone

investigation_cases.title: cooling system fan and coolant level
investigation_cases.required_tests: Inspect level/pressure/leaks, fan relays/resistors/G106 and codes before replacement
investigation_cases.caution: LHU water-pump drive conflict in generic page remains unresolved

investigation_cases.title: AF40 gearbox and integrated cooling
investigation_cases.lead_symptoms: Slipping, delayed engagement, coolant/ATF mixing, fluid leak
investigation_cases.required_tests: Verify case label/TCM faults and fluid/coolant condition; qualified temperature-controlled 70–80°C level service if safe
investigation_cases.caution: No unsupervised stall test or flushing unknown damaged gearbox

investigation_cases.title: rear support vs body mount rust
investigation_cases.lead_symptoms: Flaking/perforated rear support; suspected anchor, sill or floor damage
investigation_cases.required_tests: Professional inspection of metal integrity and rear support BODY mounts
investigation_cases.caution: Reject unsupported assumptions that removable subframe solves rusted structure

investigation_cases.title: scarce option-dependent body lighting and trim
investigation_cases.lead_symptoms: Missing/cracked headlamps, bumper and rear lamp
investigation_cases.required_tests: Verify exact VIN and options plus real deliverable quote or lawful used donor before purchase
investigation_cases.caution: Do not call a part universally extinct from one unavailable retail listing
